english.title: Attempt arson with intent to endanger life
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) attempted to commit arson in that without lawful excuse you attempted to

(A)_[destroy]_
(B)_[damage]_

by fire **(..SPECIFY THE PROPERTY..)

(C)_[to the value of **(..SPECIFY THE VALUE..)]_
(D)_[of a value unknown]_

belonging to **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..) intending to destroy or damage property or being reckless as to whether property would be destroyed or damaged and intending by the

(E)_[destruction]_
(F)_[damage]_

to endanger the life of

(G)_[another]_
(H)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSON ENDANGERED..)]_

or being reckless as to whether the life of a person would thereby be endangered
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1) of the Criminal Attempts Act 1981.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
attempted to commit arson
without lawful excuse
attempted to destroy / damage fire
property belonging to another
intending to destroy / damage such property or

intending by the destruction / damage
to endanger the life of another or
being reckless as to whether
the life of a person would thereby be endangered

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order
